body:
I noticed there's a lot of wild lettuce around my area, I've smoked the dried plant before and got minimal effects so I figured I'd bleed the plant and harvest some sap and give that a try.
For the past 2 days I went about harvesting the sap/resin, methodically cutting the tops off the wild lettuce plants with a box cutter and coming back about 30 minutes later to harvest the dried resin.  I got about a gram ball and have smoked that in the course of 2 days trying different methods of smoking.
The first attempt was like doing a dab, I slowly heated the resin on a paper clip and inhaled the vapor. I got a heavy buzz from that and felt quite relaxed. Second attempt I smoked it with some herb and got the same kind of buzz.
Third attempt (literally minutes ago) I smoked a ball of resin the size of a lady bug, I vaporized it through an oil rig, the effects were quite noticeable I'm feeling super relaxed and very zoned out, definately going to sleep well tonight. I will be playing around with this stuff for a good bit, it's definately not a placebo, I just have to do it the right way to get noticeable effects. Also it's not comparable to weed.
